What Rachel Studio Does
The Four Layers

Every listing is built on the same rigorous foundation.

Research

Verified provenance, source citations, historical guardrails, and public-safe copy.

Media

Cloudinary photo systems, room tagging, narrative photo maps, mobile crop notes, and image-by-image captions.

Publishing

Luxury single-property websites with cinematic pacing, buyer facts, inquiry paths, mobile polish, and SEO foundations.

Stewardship

Rachel remains the taste, truth, and approval layer. AI assists production; Rachel protects the standard.

The System
The Garran Hill System

Before the Site,
There Is a System.

Every final page is built from a private working structure: facts, sources, photos, captions, mobile notes, SEO language, and approval gates. The public site is only the visible surface.

The Garran Hill citation file consolidates verified historical research and supersedes earlier drafts. The Cloudinary system organises the property photo library by room, narrative act, photographer, and story use. Owner-provided notes and architectural drawings inform buyer-function facts and restoration details, but private documents are not publicly exposed.
